content.user_title: Create Slack-Ready GIFs and Emoji Animations
content.value_statement: Slack GIFs and custom emoji often fail because size, frame, and color limits are strict. This skill provides Python animation primitives, optimization helpers, and validators for GIFs that meet Slack constraints.
actual_capabilities: Validates GIF file size and dimensions for Slack messages and custom emoji.
Builds optimized GIFs from PIL images or NumPy frames.
Provides templates for bounce, spin, pulse, fade, zoom, slide, morph, and more.
Renders emojis, text, shapes, gradients, shadows, particles, flashes, and shockwaves.
Applies color palettes, easing functions, frame deduplication, and color quantization.
limitations: Requires Python dependencies such as Pillow, imageio, and numpy.
Creates local GIF files and does not upload assets to Slack.
Emoji GIFs may still need manual simplification to stay under 64 KB.
Font and emoji rendering quality can vary by operating system.

use_cases.title: Design Slack reaction emoji
use_cases.description: Create compact animated emoji that fit Slack limits and match a team communication style.

use_cases.title: Build community announcements
use_cases.description: Generate lightweight message GIFs for launches, milestones, events, and quick celebration posts.

use_cases.title: Prototype animation assets
use_cases.description: Use reusable Python primitives to test motion ideas before polishing final Slack assets.

prompt_templates.title: Create a simple emoji GIF
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 128x128 Slack emoji GIF of a cheering face that pulses twice. Optimize it for the 64 KB emoji limit.

prompt_templates.title: Make a message GIF
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 480x480 Slack message GIF for a product launch. Use bold text, confetti, and a short loop under 2 MB.

prompt_templates.title: Combine animation primitives
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Slack GIF where a rocket slides in, shakes on impact, and triggers a flash. Validate the final size.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize a difficult emoji
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a detailed 128x128 custom emoji GIF, then reduce frames, colors, and effects until it passes Slack emoji limits.

output_examples.input: Create a pulsing warning emoji for Slack.
output_examples.output: A local GIF named warning-pulse.gif with 12 frames, reduced colors, and a validation note for the 64 KB limit.

output_examples.input: Make a launch celebration GIF for a Slack message.
output_examples.output: A square message GIF with animated text, confetti, optimized colors, and a size check against the 2 MB guideline.

output_examples.input: Turn a simple idea into a reaction animation.
output_examples.output: A short animation plan, selected primitives, generated frames, saved GIF, and optimization suggestions if limits fail.

best_practices: Choose emoji or message mode before designing, because the limits are different.
Validate file size after each major animation or visual change.
Use fewer frames, solid colors, and simple motion for emoji GIFs.
anti_patterns: Do not add complex gradients or many particles to emoji GIFs.
Do not assume a GIF is Slack-ready without running the validators.
Do not use tiny text that becomes unreadable at 128x128 pixels.

faq.question: Can this skill create Slack custom emoji?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes 128x128 emoji examples and aggressive optimization for Slack custom emoji limits.

faq.question: Does it upload GIFs to Slack?
faq.answer: No. It creates and validates local GIF files. Uploading is handled outside this skill.

faq.question: What dependencies are required?
faq.answer: The toolkit uses Pillow, imageio, imageio-ffmpeg, and numpy for image creation and GIF output.

faq.question: Can it make larger message GIFs?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports 480x480 message GIFs and validates them against a 2 MB guideline.

faq.question: Why are emoji GIFs hard to optimize?
faq.answer: Slack custom emoji have a strict 64 KB limit, so frame count, colors, and effects must stay simple.

faq.question: Can I combine multiple animation effects?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is built around composable primitives such as shake, bounce, move, fade, and spin.
